winConditions.title: Reduce Life to 0
text: Each player starts with 20 life (40 for Commander). Reduce your opponent's life to 0 through combat damage, spell effects, or abilities to win.

winConditions.title: Reduce Life to 0
text: Each player starts with 40 life. Reduce each opponent's life to 0 through combat damage, spell effects, or abilities to win.

winConditions.title: Empty Library
text: If a player is required to draw a card but has no cards remaining in their library, they lose the game.

winConditions.title: Empty Library
text: If a player is required to draw a card but has no cards remaining, they lose.

winConditions.title: Poison Counters
text: A player who receives 10 or more poison counters loses the game.

winConditions.title: Poison Counters

winConditions.title: Commander Damage
text: If a player is dealt 21 or more combat damage by a single commander over the course of the game, that player loses. Damage is tracked per commander.

winConditions.title: Alternative Conditions
text: Some cards have effects that declare an automatic win (e.g., Approach of the Second Sun, Thassa's Oracle, Laboratory Maniac).

winConditions.title: Concession
text: Either player may concede at any time. Announce your concession and you lose immediately.
